user.description: Before adding this integration, set up the MQTT integration in Home Assistant and configure your SMARWI devices to use your local MQTT broker.

data_description.remote_id: The MQTT topic namespace shared by the SMARWI devices. It is not a password.

reconfigure.description: Change the MQTT namespace only after independently verifying any unconfirmed device settings. This reloads the integration if the configuration changes; it does not configure the physical devices.

data_description.remote_id: The MQTT topic namespace shared by the SMARWI devices. It is not a password.

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered SMARWI namespace
discovery_confirm.description: An online message was observed for Remote ID {remote_id}. Confirm only if this namespace belongs to your devices. This does not verify their physical state.

settings_unavailable.message: SMARWI must be available and idle to change settings

settings_invalid_readback.message: SMARWI settings readback is incomplete or invalid

setting_invalid.message: SMARWI setting is read-only or outside its allowed range

settings_unconfirmed.message: SMARWI previous settings write is unconfirmed; verify device settings before reloading the integration

settings_mismatch.message: SMARWI settings readback does not match the requested configuration

settings_unconfirmed.title: Verify SMARWI settings on {device}
settings_unconfirmed.description: A settings write could not be confirmed. Do not repeat the write or move the window to test it. Independently verify the actual device settings using the local device interface and resolve any discrepancy before reloading the integration. Reloading does not prove that the previous command succeeded. Dismiss this warning only after verification.
